subject: DI03005011

body.en:
Definition / principle

Temperature is the thermodynamic property indicating thermal state and the direction of spontaneous heat transfer. A thermometer is an instrument that measures temperature through a calibrated property that varies with temperature.

Detailed explanation and conditions

Heat is transferred energy, not temperature. Celsius and Fahrenheit use different interval sizes; kelvin is an absolute scale. Use kelvin in radiation laws, not°C. Conversions apply to temperatures; temperature differences satisfy1 K=1°C and1°C=1.8°F. Contact instruments require thermal contact/equilibrium; noncontact pyrometers infer temperature from radiation and require appropriate optical/emissivity conditions.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Thermal state તથા spontaneous heat transfer ની direction દર્શાવતી thermodynamic property Temperature છે. Temperature સાથે બદલાતી calibrated property વડે temperature માપતું instrument Thermometer છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા Conditions

Heat transferred energy છે, temperature નહીં. Celsius તથા Fahrenheit ના interval sizes જુદા છે. Kelvin absolute scale છે. Radiation laws માં kelvin લો,°C નહીં. Temperature differences માટે 1 K=1°C તથા 1°C=1.8°F છે. Contact instruments માટે thermal contact/equilibrium અને noncontact pyrometers માટે યોગ્ય radiation, optical તથા emissivity conditions જરૂરી છે.

body.en:
Definition

A liquid-expansion contact thermometer containing mercury in a glass bulb and capillary.

Principle

Mercury expands relative to its glass enclosure when heated; the calibrated column length indicates temperature.

Construction

A thin-walled glass bulb stores mercury and joins a narrow, uniform-bore capillary. A marked stem carries the temperature scale; space above the column accommodates expansion. The bulb and the prescribed immersion length form the sensing region. A protective housing may shield industrial instruments without changing the sensing principle. The ordinary industrial design does not require the constriction used in a clinical maximum thermometer.

Working

Place the bulb at the specified measuring position and immerse to the instrument’s prescribed depth. Heat transfer brings the bulb and liquid toward the medium temperature; the apparent volume increase drives mercury upward in the capillary. After stabilization read the meniscus at eye level without parallax. Cooling contracts the column and lowers the reading. Partial-immersion and total-immersion instruments require their respective immersion conditions; an exposed stem can create error.

Applications

Moderate-temperature liquid baths and local indication where the approved instrument/material is suitable.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Fragile glass, slow response and no convenient remote electrical output. Mercury is toxic; do not use it as a default student reagent or handle a spill without the institutional hazardous-material SOP. Range depends on glass/fill/design; ordinary mercury cannot measure below its freezing point.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Glass bulb તથા capillary માં રહેલા mercury ના expansion વડે temperature માપતું contact thermometer છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

ગરમીથી glass enclosure ની સરખામણીએ mercury વધુ expand થાય છે. Calibrated column length temperature દર્શાવે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Thin-walled glass bulb માં mercury હોય છે અને તે narrow uniform-bore capillary સાથે જોડાય છે. Marked stem પર temperature scale છે. Column ઉપર expansion માટે જગ્યા હોય છે. Bulb તથા prescribed immersion length sensing region છે. Industrial protective housing glass ને shield કરી શકે છે. Clinical maximum thermometer જેવી constriction ordinary industrial design માટે જરૂરી નથી.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Bulb ને measuring position પર instrument મુજબ depth સુધી immerse કરો. Heat transfer થી bulb/mercury medium temperature તરફ આવે છે. Apparent volume વધવાથી column capillary માં ઊંચો ચડે છે. Stabilize થયા પછી eye level પર meniscus વાંચો. Cooling થી column નીચે આવે છે. Partial તથા total immersion instruments ની prescribed conditions અલગ છે. Exposed stem થી error થઈ શકે છે.

ઉપયોગો

Approved material/range યોગ્ય હોય ત્યાં liquid baths તથા local temperature indication.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Glass fragile છે, response ધીમો અને convenient remote electrical output નથી. Mercury toxic છે; default student reagent ન માનો અને spill માટે institutional hazardous-material SOP અનુસરો. Range glass/fill/design પ્રમાણે છે; mercury freezing point નીચે ordinary instrument કામ ન કરે.

body.en:
Definition

A mechanical thermometer using the bending of two bonded metals with different expansion coefficients.

Principle

Unequal thermal expansion produces curvature; on heating the higher-expansion layer lies on the outside of the bend.

Construction

Two thin metal strips are firmly bonded along their length and formed as a spiral or helix to obtain useful angular movement. One end is fixed to the support; the other connects to a spindle and pointer. A graduated dial and protective stem/case complete the assembly. The drawing identifies the bonded high- and low-expansion layers, the fixed end and the moving spindle.

Working

Temperature change heats both layers, but their free expansion would be different. Bonding forces a combined bend; the spiral winds or unwinds and turns the spindle. The pointer moves over a temperature-calibrated scale. When temperature returns, the elastic strip tends to recover its previous shape. The direction of pointer movement depends on the winding and linkage, so it is established by calibration rather than assumed from the sketch alone.

Applications

Robust local dial indication in ovens, ducts and process equipment.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Moderate accuracy; hysteresis, mechanical friction and stem-conduction errors can occur. Avoid vibration and temperatures beyond the metal/design rating.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

જુદા expansion coefficients ધરાવતી bonded metal layers ના bending વડે temperature માપતું mechanical thermometer છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Unequal thermal expansion થી curvature બને છે. Heating વખતે higher-expansion layer bend ની બહારની બાજુ આવે છે.

રચના (Construction)

બે thin metal strips length પર firmly bond કરીને spiral/helix બનાવાય છે જેથી પૂરતું angular movement મળે. એક end support પર fixed અને બીજું spindle/pointer સાથે જોડાય છે. Graduated dial તથા protective stem/case હોય છે. Drawing માં high/low-expansion layers, fixed end તથા moving spindle ઓળખાવ્યાં છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

બંને layers ગરમ થાય છે, પણ તેમની free expansion જુદી હોય છે. Bonding થી combined bend થાય છે. Spiral wind/unwind થઈ spindle ફેરવે છે. Pointer calibrated scale પર ખસે છે. Temperature પાછું આવે ત્યારે elastic strip પાછું વળે છે. Pointer ની direction winding/linkage પર આધારિત હોવાથી calibration મુજબ નક્કી થાય છે.

ઉપયોગો

Ovens, ducts તથા process equipment માં robust local dial indication.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Accuracy moderate છે. Hysteresis, mechanical friction તથા stem-conduction errors થઈ શકે છે. Vibration તથા design rating બહારનું temperature ટાળો.

body.en:
Definition

A thermometer that converts temperature-induced pressure change in a sealed filling system into spring motion.

Principle

Expansion or vapour-pressure change of a suitable filling medium changes pressure; an elastic pressure element produces indication.

Construction

A sensing bulb, a small-bore capillary and an elastic pressure spring such as a Bourdon element form one sealed system. The bulb is installed at the process point while the spring, dial and linkage can be remote. The chosen liquid, gas or vapour fill and available expansion volume determine the operating behaviour. The bulb, capillary and receiver must remain intact as a matched system.

Working

The bulb exchanges heat with the process and its filling medium changes pressure according to the fill type. This pressure is transmitted along the capillary and elastically deflects the pressure spring. A linkage turns the pointer against a calibrated temperature dial. Cooling reverses the pressure and movement. Ambient temperature effects on capillary/receiver and elevation effects may require compensation; the exact correction depends on the filled-system class.

Applications

Remote mechanical indication without locating the dial at a hot or inaccessible bulb.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Capillary damage/leak destroys calibration; long capillaries add lag. Do not cut or bend below the specified radius. Filling medium and bulb location must suit the range and service.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Sealed filling system ના temperature-dependent pressure ને spring motion માં ફેરવતું thermometer છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Suitable filling medium ના expansion અથવા vapour-pressure change થી pressure બદલાય છે. Elastic pressure element indication આપે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Sensing bulb, small-bore capillary તથા Bourdon જેવા elastic pressure spring નું sealed system હોય છે. Bulb process પર અને spring, dial/linkage remote હોઈ શકે છે. Liquid, gas અથવા vapour fill તથા expansion volume થી behaviour નક્કી થાય છે. Bulb, capillary તથા receiver matched sealed system તરીકે intact હોવા જોઈએ.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Bulb process સાથે heat exchange કરે છે. Fill type પ્રમાણે pressure બદલાય છે. Capillary pressure spring સુધી pressure પહોંચાડે છે. Spring deflect થતાં linkage pointer ફેરવે છે. Cooling માં movement reverse થાય છે. Capillary/receiver ના ambient effects તથા elevation માટે compensation લાગી શકે છે; exact correction filling-system class પર આધારિત છે.

ઉપયોગો

Hot અથવા inaccessible bulb થી દૂર mechanical dial indication.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Capillary damage/leak થી calibration બગડે છે. Long capillary lag વધારે છે. Cut ન કરો અને specified bend radius કરતાં વધુ ન વાળો. Fill તથા bulb location range/service પ્રમાણે પસંદ કરો.

body.en:
Definition

A thermometer that determines temperature from the electrical resistance of a calibrated sensing element.

Principle

For a metal RTD, resistance generally increases with temperature. Platinum offers stable, reproducible resistance-temperature behaviour.

Construction

A fine platinum wire coil or thin-film element is supported on an insulating former and enclosed in a protective sheath with suitable insulation. Lead wires connect it to a bridge or electronic resistance-measuring circuit. A thermowell may isolate the probe from the process. The illustration uses separate current and voltage leads of a four-wire connection; two- and three-wire versions require their appropriate lead-resistance treatment.

Working

A small known excitation current is passed through the element and the voltage or bridge imbalance is measured. The electronics determines resistance and converts it to temperature using the correct RTD curve. For a four-wire arrangement, voltage-sense leads carry negligible current and largely exclude lead-voltage drops. Excitation must be small enough to limit self-heating. The common Pt100 designation means nominal100Ωat0°C, not100Ωat room temperature.

Applications

Accurate, repeatable industrial liquid/gas temperature measurement over the selected probe’s rated range.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Requires excitation and lead compensation; self-heating, poor immersion and insulation leakage cause error. The linear relation shown is an approximation, not the complete platinum standard curve.

Governing relation / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Calibrated sensing element ની electrical resistance પરથી temperature નક્કી કરતું thermometer છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Metal RTD માં temperature વધતાં resistance સામાન્ય રીતે વધે છે. Platinum stable, reproducible resistance-temperature behaviour આપે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Fine platinum wire coil અથવા thin-film element insulating former પર support થઈ protective sheath માં યોગ્ય insulation સાથે બંધ હોય છે. Lead wires bridge/electronic resistance circuit સાથે જોડાય છે. Thermowell process isolation આપી શકે છે. Drawing four-wire connection ના અલગ current/voltage leads દર્શાવે છે. Two/three-wire designs માં યોગ્ય lead-resistance treatment જોઈએ.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

નાનો known excitation current element માં પસાર કરીને voltage અથવા bridge imbalance માપાય છે. Electronics resistance પરથી યોગ્ય RTD curve વડે temperature મેળવે છે. Four-wire arrangement ના voltage-sense leads માં negligible current હોવાથી lead voltage-drop નો અસર ઘણો ઘટે છે. Excitation ઓછો રાખવાથી self-heating ઘટે છે. Pt100 એટલે 0°C પર nominal100Ω, room temperature પર નહીં.

ઉપયોગો

Selected probe ના rated range માં accurate તથા repeatable industrial liquid/gas temperature measurement.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Excitation તથા lead compensation જોઈએ. Self-heating, poor immersion તથા insulation leakage થી error થાય છે. Linear relation approximation છે, પૂર્ણ platinum standard curve નહીં.

મૂળ સંબંધ / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition / principle

Seebeck effect is thermoelectric EMF in a circuit of dissimilar conductors exposed to temperature differences. Peltier effect is reversible heat absorption/release at a junction carrying current. Thomson effect is reversible distributed heat absorption/release when current flows through a homogeneous conductor with a temperature gradient.

Detailed explanation and conditions

The syllabus spelling “See-back” refers to Seebeck. For Peltier and Thomson effects, reversing current reverses the reversible heat contribution; Joule heating remains proportional to current squared and does not reverse. Seebeck voltage depends on the conductor materials and temperature distribution/reference temperatures; it is not a current-generated heating effect. The thermocouple uses Seebeck measurement with minimal measurement current.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Dissimilar conductors માં temperature difference થી thermoelectric EMF મળે તે Seebeck effect છે. Current ધરાવતા junction પર reversible heat absorption/release Peltier effect છે. Homogeneous conductor માં current તથા temperature gradient સાથે distributed reversible heat effect Thomson effect છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા Conditions

Syllabus નું “See-back” એટલે Seebeck છે. Peltier/Thomson ના reversible heat contribution નો sign current reverse કરતાં reverse થાય છે. Joule heating current squared પ્રમાણે હોવાથી reverse થતું નથી. Seebeck voltage materials તથા temperature/reference conditions પર આધારિત છે; તે current-generated heating નથી. Thermocouple negligible measuring current સાથે Seebeck effect વાપરે છે.

સમીકરણો / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition

A temperature sensor using two dissimilar conductors and their thermoelectric voltage relative to a known or compensated reference.

Principle

The Seebeck voltage represents the integral of differential thermopower between measuring and reference temperatures.

Construction

Two selected alloy wires are welded or otherwise joined at a measuring junction. The wires are electrically insulated from each other except at that junction and enclosed in a metal/ceramic sheath suitable for the process. Extension or compensating cable connects the sensor to reference terminals and a high-input-impedance indicator/transmitter. Cold-junction compensation senses the terminal temperature. A thermowell or protective tube can isolate the assembly; grounded, ungrounded and exposed junctions trade response against isolation/protection.

Working

Heat brings the measuring junction toward process temperature. The dissimilar conductors develop a small EMF relative to the reference terminals. The instrument measures it, accounts for reference temperature and uses the correct thermocouple-type characteristic to obtain hot-junction temperature. Cold-junction compensation is not a claim that the terminals physically stay at0°C. Polarity, correct extension cable and homogeneous wire condition are essential; EMF is nonlinear over a wide range.

Applications

Representative industrial ranges—not universal sensor ratings: K(NiCr/NiAl)about−200to1200°C; J(Fe/CuNi)0to750°C; T(Cu/CuNi)−200to350°C; E(NiCr/CuNi)−200to900°C. R(Pt13%Rh/Pt)and S(Pt10%Rh/Pt)about0to1600°C; B(Pt30%Rh/Pt6%Rh)commonly used about600to1700°C. Select by atmosphere, range, response and durability.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Actual limits depend on wire size, sheath, insulation, atmosphere and manufacturer. EMF drift, oxidation, noise and wrong compensation cable cause error. Use the proper type table, not one constant sensitivity over the entire range.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

બે dissimilar conductors ના thermoelectric voltage ને known/compensated reference સાથે સરખાવી temperature માપતું sensor છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Measuring તથા reference temperatures વચ્ચે differential thermopower નું integral Seebeck voltage આપે છે.

રચના (Construction)

પસંદ કરેલા બે alloy wires measuring junction પર weld/join થાય છે. તે junction સિવાય wires પરસ્પર insulated અને process મુજબ metal/ceramic sheath માં હોય છે. Extension/compensating cable reference terminals તથા high-input-impedance indicator/transmitter સાથે જોડાય છે. Cold-junction compensation terminal temperature sense કરે છે. Thermowell/protective tube isolation આપે છે. Grounded, ungrounded તથા exposed junctions માં response, isolation/protection જુદાં હોય છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Measuring junction process temperature તરફ આવે છે. Dissimilar conductors reference terminals સામે નાનું EMF આપે છે. Instrument EMF માપી reference temperature correction તથા યોગ્ય type curve વડે hot-junction temperature મેળવે છે. Cold-junction compensation નો અર્થ terminals physically0°C પર હોય એવો નથી. Polarity, યોગ્ય extension cable તથા homogeneous wires જરૂરી છે. Wide range માં EMF nonlinear છે.

ઉપયોગો

આ representative industrial ranges છે, universal ratings નહીં: K(NiCr/NiAl)આશરે−200 થી 1200°C; J(Fe/CuNi)0 થી 750°C; T(Cu/CuNi)−200 થી 350°C; E(NiCr/CuNi)−200 થી 900°C. R(Pt13%Rh/Pt) તથા S(Pt10%Rh/Pt)આશરે 0 થી 1600°C; B(Pt30%Rh/Pt6%Rh)સામાન્ય high-temperature use આશરે 600 થી 1700°C છે. Atmosphere, range, response તથા durability પ્રમાણે પસંદ કરો.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Actual limits wire size, sheath, insulation, atmosphere તથા manufacturer પર આધારિત છે. EMF drift, oxidation, noise તથા wrong cable થી error થાય છે. Proper type table લો; આખા range માટે એક constant sensitivity ન લો.

body.en:
Definition

A noncontact instrument that infers temperature from thermal radiation received from a target.

Principle

Radiation intensity depends strongly on absolute temperature and emissivity. A suitable detector converts collected radiation into a measurable signal.

Construction

A sighting/collecting optical system directs radiation from a defined target spot onto a detector such as a thermopile or appropriate photoelectric detector. The assembly includes an aperture, selected spectral response, signal processing and an indicator. Protective windows or cooling/purging may be provided for the service. The drawing shows a thermal-detector form; real instruments operate over specified spectral bands rather than every wavelength.

Working

Aim so the target fills the required field of view. Radiation passes through the optics and heats or excites the detector. The resulting electrical signal is processed using calibration and the configured emissivity/background assumptions to show temperature. A dirty window, smaller-than-required target or reflected hot surroundings changes received radiation and can cause a wrong reading without any true target-temperature change.

Applications

Furnaces, moving or inaccessible hot surfaces and processes unsuitable for contact probes.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Emissivity, line-of-sight, spot size, window transmission and atmosphere matter. The total-radiation law shown is a physical idealization; band-limited instruments use their calibrated spectral response.

Governing relation / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Target માંથી મળતી thermal radiation પરથી temperature નક્કી કરતું noncontact instrument છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Radiation intensity absolute temperature તથા emissivity પર આધારિત છે. Suitable detector collected radiation ને measurable signal માં ફેરવે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Collecting/sighting optics defined target spot ની radiation ને thermopile અથવા યોગ્ય detector પર focus કરે છે. Aperture, spectral response, signal processing તથા indicator હોય છે. Service પ્રમાણે protective window, cooling/purging મળી શકે છે. Drawing thermal-detector form બતાવે છે. Real instruments specified spectral band માં કામ કરે છે, બધી wavelengths પર નહીં.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Target જરૂરી field of view ભરે તે રીતે aim કરો. Optics મારફતે radiation detector ને heat/excite કરે છે. Signal ને calibration તથા configured emissivity/background assumptions વડે temperature માં ફેરવાય છે. Dirty window, નાનો target અથવા hot-surrounding reflections થી actual targettemperature બદલાયા વગર પણ reading ખોટી થઈ શકે છે.

ઉપયોગો

Furnaces, moving/inaccessible hot surfaces તથા contact probe માટે unsuitable processes.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Emissivity, line-of-sight, spot size, window transmission તથા atmosphere મહત્વના છે. Total-radiation law physical idealization છે. Band-limited instruments પોતાની calibrated spectral response વાપરે છે.

મૂળ સંબંધ / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition

A visual noncontact pyrometer comparing the brightness of a hot target with a calibrated lamp filament.

Principle

At a selected wavelength, the filament disappears against the target image when their apparent brightnesses match.

Construction

A telescope forms a target image in the plane of an electric reference-lamp filament. A red/spectral filter limits the viewing band; an eyepiece lets the observer compare target and filament. A battery/current-control circuit adjusts the lamp, and a calibrated current scale indicates brightness temperature. An absorbing screen may extend the range. The optics, filament plane and viewing path shown must remain aligned.

Working

Focus on a sufficiently luminous target and adjust the lamp current. If the filament is darker than the background, increase its brightness; when too bright, reduce it. At the matching setting, the filament visually merges into the target. The current-calibrated indication gives brightness temperature under the instrument’s calibration conditions. For a nonblack target, emissivity/window corrections are needed to infer true temperature; brightness matching alone does not eliminate them.

Applications

High-temperature glowing furnaces and incandescent surfaces visible through a suitable sighting path.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Needs a sufficiently bright target and observer judgement; not a low-temperature contact thermometer. Follow eye-safety and hot-process viewing SOPs; never look at dangerous sources without the specified protective optics.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Hot target ની brightness ને calibrated lamp filament સાથે સરખાવતું visual noncontact pyrometer છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Selected wavelength પર filament તથા target image ની apparent brightness સમાન થાય ત્યારે filament disappear થયેલું દેખાય છે.

રચના (Construction)

Telescope target image ને reference-lamp filament ના plane માં બનાવે છે. Red/spectral filter viewing band મર્યાદિત કરે છે. Eyepiece વડે target/filament compare થાય છે. Battery/current-control circuit lamp current બદલે છે અને calibrated scale brightness temperature આપે છે. Absorbing screen થી range વધારી શકાય છે. Optics, filament plane તથા viewing path aligned હોવા જોઈએ.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

પૂરતા luminous target પર focus કરીને lamp current બદલો. Filament background કરતાં dark હોય તો brightness વધારો અને વધારે bright હોય તો ઘટાડો. Match સમયે filament target માં visually merge થાય છે. Current-calibrated reading brightness temperature આપે છે. Nonblack target માટે true temperature મેળવવા emissivity/window corrections જોઈએ. Brightness matching થી આ errors આપમેળે દૂર થતા નથી.

ઉપયોગો

યોગ્ય sighting path ધરાવતા glowing furnaces તથા incandescent surfaces.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

પૂરતી brightness તથા observer judgement જોઈએ; low-temperature contact thermometer નથી. Eye-safety તથા hot-process viewing SOP અનુસરો. Specified protective optics વગર dangerous source ન જુઓ.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Temperature,scales and thermometer.
q.gu: Temperature,Scales તથા Thermometer ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Temperature is the thermodynamic property indicating thermal state and the direction of spontaneous heat transfer. A thermometer is an instrument that measures temperature through a calibrated property that varies with temperature.
a.gu: Thermal state તથા spontaneous heat transfer ની direction દર્શાવતી thermodynamic property Temperature છે. Temperature સાથે બદલાતી calibrated property વડે temperature માપતું instrument Thermometer છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Mercury-in-glass thermometer.
q.gu: Mercury-in-glass Thermometer ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A liquid-expansion contact thermometer containing mercury in a glass bulb and capillary. Mercury expands relative to its glass enclosure when heated; the calibrated column length indicates temperature.
a.gu: Glass bulb તથા capillary માં રહેલા mercury ના expansion વડે temperature માપતું contact thermometer છે. ગરમીથી glass enclosure ની સરખામણીએ mercury વધુ expand થાય છે. Calibrated column length temperature દર્શાવે છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Bimetallic thermometer.
q.gu: Bimetallic Thermometer ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A mechanical thermometer using the bending of two bonded metals with different expansion coefficients. Unequal thermal expansion produces curvature; on heating the higher-expansion layer lies on the outside of the bend.
a.gu: જુદા expansion coefficients ધરાવતી bonded metal layers ના bending વડે temperature માપતું mechanical thermometer છે. Unequal thermal expansion થી curvature બને છે. Heating વખતે higher-expansion layer bend ની બહારની બાજુ આવે છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Pressure-spring / filled-system thermometer.
q.gu: Pressure-spring / Filled-system Thermometer ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A thermometer that converts temperature-induced pressure change in a sealed filling system into spring motion. Expansion or vapour-pressure change of a suitable filling medium changes pressure; an elastic pressure element produces indication.
a.gu: Sealed filling system ના temperature-dependent pressure ને spring motion માં ફેરવતું thermometer છે. Suitable filling medium ના expansion અથવા vapour-pressure change થી pressure બદલાય છે. Elastic pressure element indication આપે છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Resistance thermometer / RTD.
q.gu: Resistance Thermometer / RTD ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A thermometer that determines temperature from the electrical resistance of a calibrated sensing element. For a metal RTD, resistance generally increases with temperature. Platinum offers stable, reproducible resistance-temperature behaviour.
a.gu: Calibrated sensing element ની electrical resistance પરથી temperature નક્કી કરતું thermometer છે. Metal RTD માં temperature વધતાં resistance સામાન્ય રીતે વધે છે. Platinum stable, reproducible resistance-temperature behaviour આપે છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Seebeck,Peltier and Thomson effects.
q.gu: Seebeck,Peltier તથા Thomson Effects ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Seebeck effect is thermoelectric EMF in a circuit of dissimilar conductors exposed to temperature differences. Peltier effect is reversible heat absorption/release at a junction carrying current. Thomson effect is reversible distributed heat absorption/release when current flows through a homogeneous conductor with a temperature gradient.
a.gu: Dissimilar conductors માં temperature difference થી thermoelectric EMF મળે તે Seebeck effect છે. Current ધરાવતા junction પર reversible heat absorption/release Peltier effect છે. Homogeneous conductor માં current તથા temperature gradient સાથે distributed reversible heat effect Thomson effect છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Industrial thermocouple and working ranges.
q.gu: Industrial Thermocouple તથા Working Ranges ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A temperature sensor using two dissimilar conductors and their thermoelectric voltage relative to a known or compensated reference. The Seebeck voltage represents the integral of differential thermopower between measuring and reference temperatures.
a.gu: બે dissimilar conductors ના thermoelectric voltage ને known/compensated reference સાથે સરખાવી temperature માપતું sensor છે. Measuring તથા reference temperatures વચ્ચે differential thermopower નું integral Seebeck voltage આપે છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Radiation pyrometer.
q.gu: Radiation Pyrometer ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A noncontact instrument that infers temperature from thermal radiation received from a target. Radiation intensity depends strongly on absolute temperature and emissivity. A suitable detector converts collected radiation into a measurable signal.
a.gu: Target માંથી મળતી thermal radiation પરથી temperature નક્કી કરતું noncontact instrument છે. Radiation intensity absolute temperature તથા emissivity પર આધારિત છે. Suitable detector collected radiation ને measurable signal માં ફેરવે છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Disappearing-filament optical pyrometer.
q.gu: Disappearing-filament Optical Pyrometer ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A visual noncontact pyrometer comparing the brightness of a hot target with a calibrated lamp filament. At a selected wavelength, the filament disappears against the target image when their apparent brightnesses match.
a.gu: Hot target ની brightness ને calibrated lamp filament સાથે સરખાવતું visual noncontact pyrometer છે. Selected wavelength પર filament તથા target image ની apparent brightness સમાન થાય ત્યારે filament disappear થયેલું દેખાય છે.
